# Vendored: Omni Collective v7 Frontier model code

The `.py` files of [Kai9987kai/supermix-omni-collective-v7-frontier](https://huggingface.co/Kai9987kai/supermix-omni-collective-v7-frontier)
(`OmniCollectiveNetV7 = OmniCollectiveNetV4`). The weights and meta json are downloaded here by `external/fetch_base.py`.
The trained Expanse checkpoint already contains the frozen v7 net, so chatting does not need them.
